result.card: This pull request removes redundant nested JSON quotes from block hash arguments in the bitcoin-cli help examples for gettxoutsetinfo and getblockstats. Following earlier changes allowing unquoted string arguments, the help examples still displayed nested quotes ('"<hash>"'), presenting unnecessarily complex usage patterns to CLI users. The change is a minor documentation cleanup motivated by feedback on PR #33230, carrying no functional changes or dependencies.
